theater: 烏拉圭東部卡甘查至蒙得維的亞

battle.name: 烏拉圭內戰
battle.theater: 烏拉圭東部卡甘查至蒙得維的亞
battle.brief: 一八三九年三月起，弗魯克圖奧索·里維拉在蒙得維的亞當選總統並向布宜諾斯艾利斯省長羅薩斯宣戰，恩特雷里奧斯省長埃查瓜隨即率聯邦軍越過烏拉圭河入侵，十二月二十九日在卡甘查敗北，戰事延成十二年的「大戰」，以蒙得維的亞九年圍城最著名。卡面輪發手槍三百年前已被燧發手槍取代。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 交戰的兩方是烏拉圭的兩個政黨，但兵力與支援都來自境外，實質是一場國際化的內戰。一方是里維拉率領的紅黨，核心是蒙得維的亞的東方國民守備隊與市區民兵，另有以國籍編成的外國兵團：法國營、西班牙與巴斯克營、加里波第率領的義大利遠征軍，以及由新獲釋的非洲奴隸組成、規模達五千人的自由非洲人營；阿根廷方面，流亡的單元派將領拉瓦爾、帕斯與朗多奧組成「解放軍團」投效紅黨，科連特斯省的佩德羅·費雷與後來的恩特雷里奧斯省、聖菲省先後站在同一邊，里奧格蘭德共和國在開戰之初提供武裝與海運協助，巴西帝國與英法兩國的艦隊則在後段的圍城戰中直接介入。另一方是奧里韋率領的白黨，本部是烏拉圭鄉村的土地利益與奧里韋的私兵，並得到布宜諾斯艾利斯省長羅薩斯的聯邦軍全力支持：恩特雷里奧斯省的帕斯夸爾·埃查瓜、巴拉圭的安赫爾·帕切科與奧里韋之弟伊格納西奧各自帶兵，阿根廷聯邦海軍在威廉·布朗率領下也歸入此方。一八三九年之後形勢拉開成兩個政府並存的局面：城內是「防務政府」，城外是設於塞里托的奧里韋政府；一八四三年起奧里韋的聯邦軍與白黨軍在蒙得維的亞城郊設三處營壘，一八五一年聯邦軍更增至一萬一千至一萬四千人，而城內守軍連同外國援軍約一萬人。
countriesEn: The two sides were the two parties of Uruguay, but the men and the support came from abroad, and the war was in substance an internationalised civil war. On one side stood Fructuoso Rivera's Colorados, centred on the Oriental national guard and the civic militia of Montevideo, with foreign units organised by nationality: French battalions, Spanish and Basque companies, Garibaldi's Italian expedition, and the battalions of free Africans formed from the newly emancipated and numbering some five thousand. On the Argentine side the exiled Unitarian leaders Lavalle, Paz and Rondeau formed the Legión Libertadora and threw in with the Colorados; the province of Corrientes under Pedro Ferré, and later Entre Ríos and Santa Fe, stood on the same side; the Riograndense Republic gave arms and shipping in the opening phase, and the Empire of Brazil and the British and French squadrons intervened directly in the later siege. On the other side stood Manuel Oribe's Blancos, whose base was the agricultural interest of the Uruguayan countryside and Oribe's own armed following, backed without reserve by the federal army of Buenos Aires under Juan Manuel de Rosas: Pascual Echagüe of Entre Ríos, Ángel Pacheco of Paraguay and Oribe's brother Ignacio each brought troops, and the Argentine confederate navy under William Brown was on that side as well. After 1839 the shape of the war became two governments existing at once: the Gobierno de la Defensa inside the city and Oribe's Cerrito government outside it. From 1843 Oribe's federal and Blanco troops held three camps on the approaches to Montevideo, and by 1851 the federal army numbered eleven to fourteen thousand men, against some ten thousand in the city when foreign contingents are counted.
people: 這場內戰的主角是幾個各自帶兵的將帥，每個人本身就是一支軍隊。弗魯克圖奧索·里維拉是烏拉圭第一位總統，騎術嫻熟，於一八三九年三月一日當選，四十八歲時仍能親自衝鋒，是紅黨的象徵；他的宿敵曼努埃爾·奧里韋是三十三位東方人之一，掌政後卻被指為暴政，遂在城郊設政府對抗。帕斯夸爾·埃查瓜是恩特雷里奧斯省長、聯邦名將，一八三九年率軍越過烏拉圭河入境外，在卡甘查被里維拉擊敗後退回本土，後來在卡阿瓜蘇再輸給獨臂將軍何塞·瑪麗亞·帕斯。烏拉圭獨立領袖胡安·安東尼奧·拉瓦萊哈在白黨與聯邦軍之間遊走，既是羅薩斯的盟友又是紅黨的痛腳。威廉·布朗是阿根廷海軍的元帥，一八三八年十月法國海軍攻佔馬丁·加西亞島時，他的東方分艦隊被解除武裝，此後轉投奧里韋一方，成為白黨唯一的海上力量。加里波第帶領的義大利遠征軍是圍城期最出名的外來兵團，他不只指揮步卒，還在拉普拉塔河口用自購與徵用的帆船與汽船組成臨時分艦隊，試圖突破封鎖。城內的實際主持者是何塞·梅爾喬·帕切科·伊·奧貝斯與後來的華金·蘇亞雷斯；英國在一八四六年派出第七十三步兵團馳援，法國與英國的艦隊則在拉普拉塔河口反覆封鎖布宜諾斯艾利斯，把這場內戰變成列強與羅薩斯之間的較量。
peopleEn: The war was carried by a handful of caudillos each of whom was himself an army. Fructuoso Rivera, Uruguay's first president, elected on 1 March 1839, was a horseman of real skill and, at forty-eight, still led charges in person; he became the personification of the Colorado cause. His rival Manuel Oribe, one of the Thirty-Three Orientals, had governed the country and was then branded as a tyrant, so he set up a government on the outskirts of the city in defiance. Pascual Echagüe, governor of Entre Ríos and a federal general, crossed the Uruguay River into the country in 1839, was beaten by Rivera at Cagancha and withdrew, and was later defeated at Caaguazú by the one-armed general José María Paz. Juan Antonio Lavalleja, the independence leader, moved between the Blancos and the federal army, an ally of Rosas and a thorn in Rivera's side. William Brown, the marshal of the Argentine navy, saw his Oriental squadron disarmed when the French took Martín García Island in October 1838, and after that he served Oribe and became the only naval force the Blancos had. Garibaldi's Italian expedition was the best known of the foreign contingents during the siege, and it was not only infantry: he built an improvised squadron of purchased and requisitioned sailing ships and steamers in the mouth of the Río de la Plata and tried to break the blockade. Inside the city the practical direction lay with Melchor Pacheco y Obes and later Joaquín Suárez; Britain sent the 73rd Regiment of Foot to the city in 1846, and the French and British squadrons blockaded Buenos Aires in the Río de la Plata again and again, which turned the civil war into a contest between the great powers and Rosas.
kits: 卡面這件輪發手槍在一八三九年已是三百年前的古物，它在體系裡的位置只剩下兩點。一是技術上的源頭：輪發機構是第一種不需火繩的機械擊發裝置，十七世紀被燧發槍取代，但它確立的「後膛擊發、槍機自帶火種」這條路線一直貫穿到雷管手槍，十九世紀的烏拉圭手槍正是這條線的末端產品；二是陳列上的殘餘：這類早期火器作為退役庫存與古物留在各國軍械庫中，具體存留的數目沒有可靠記載，但它們是烏拉圭軍械沿革最直观的註腳。真正上陣的是短兵：軍官與騎兵配燧發手槍與雷管手槍，步卒用滑膛燧發或雷管步槍配刺刀，騎兵用馬刀與卡賓槍。烏拉圭人特別看重一件護具，即直徑約三十公分的鋼盾，成為東方民兵與義勇兵在蒙得維的亞防務中的標誌性裝備，後來也隨紅黨隊伍出現在卡甘查與各處陣地。砲方面，一八三九年十二月的卡甘查一役，紅軍有十門砲，聯邦軍只有三門四磅砲，這個數字差正是那一役的關鍵；圍城階段則是雙方在城郊與城頭部署的野戰砲與攻城砲，以及舊西班牙殖民時期留下的城牆、角樓與棱堡。進攻還靠船：加里波第的臨時分艦隊用徵用與購買的帆船與汽船嘗試衝開封鎖，運兵與運糧的任務則落在河船與牛車上。
kitsEn: The wheellock on this card was already three hundred years old in 1839, and only two things about it remain in the system. The first is technical descent: the wheel lock was the first mechanical ignition that needed no match, it was displaced by the flintlock in the seventeenth century, but the line it established, ignition at the breech with a mechanism carrying its own source of sparks, runs straight through to the percussion pistol, and the pistols of the 1830s are the far end of that line. The second is what survives on show: arms of that early type remained in arsenals as retired stores and as curiosities, and while no reliable count of them survives, they remain the most visible annotation of the military inheritance of Uruguay. What actually went into the field were the hand weapons: flintlock and percussion pistols for officers and cavalry, smoothbore flintlock or percussion muskets with bayonets for the infantry, sabre and carbine for the horsemen. The Uruguayans set particular store on one piece of protection, the steel shield of about thirty centimetres across, which became the emblematic equipment of the Oriental militia and volunteers in the defence of Montevideo and later appeared with the Colorado columns at Cagancha and in the field. In artillery, the difference at the Battle of Cagancha in December 1839 was decisive: the Colorados had ten guns and the federal army three four-pounders. Through the siege the two sides emplaced field and siege guns on the approaches and the walls, using fortifications inherited from the Spanish colonial town, with its ramparts, towers and bastions. The attack also depended on shipping: Garibaldi's improvised squadron of bought and requisitioned sailing ships and steamers tried to force the blockade open, while river craft and ox carts carried the men and the provisions.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術可以分成三段。一八三九至一八四一年在阿根廷境內打的是消耗與追擊：聯邦軍靠河運與陸軍的優勢在帕戈拉戈擊潰拉瓦爾，隨後把戰線推過巴拉那河，紅黨與單元派聯軍屢戰屢退，一八四〇年拉瓦爾退入聖菲，一八四一年十月九日在胡胡伊省一場小戰中陣亡，這一段沒有會戰，只有對退卻中的縱隊的持續襲擾。一八三九年七月二十九日埃查瓜與拉瓦萊哈自薩爾托渡過烏拉圭河入境的行動本身即是一記側翼迂迴：聯邦軍避開里維拉在杜拉松諾與多羅的正面，以快速推進企圖直取蒙得維的亞，里維拉則用「不與主力交鋒」的辦法，退過克格河、內格河，在聖露西亞河上架起阻截線，靠游擊消耗敵軍分隊，同時把整個戰爭拖成持久戰，卡甘查一役則是他唯一一次正面交鋒。卡甘查的部署寫在數字上：里維拉以約三千人、其中騎兵佔多數、另有十門砲，把前鋒八百人交給阿納克萊托·梅迪納，左翼六百人交給安赫爾·努涅斯，中央的步兵與砲兵約七百人交給恩里克·馬丁內斯，右翼五百人交給福圖納托·西爾瓦，預備隊四百人交給費利克斯·阿吉亞爾；埃查瓜一側估計六千至七千五百人，兩翼各四千，中央只有五百人與三門四磅砲。兩翼騎兵一度擊潰紅軍騎兵，卻因追擊過度而失去配合，中央的聯邦步兵被紅軍的掘壕與火線擋住，紅軍預備隊一衝即潰其中心，聯邦軍遂退回恩特雷里奧斯。此後的圍城戰是城市防禦的教科書：蒙得維的亞憑舊城牆、角樓與棱堡固守九年，守軍由東方民兵、法國營、義大利營與自由非洲人營組成，靠河港與海上補給維持，圍城軍則在城郊三處營壘輪番進攻，最後一八五一年由恩特雷里奧斯的烏爾基薩在佩桑杜渡河、巴西帝軍一萬六千人自陸路進軍，加里波第的海軍在河口掩護，才解了圍城之圍。
tacticsEn: The tactics of this war fall into three phases. From 1839 to 1841 the fighting took place on Argentine territory and was a war of attrition and pursuit: the federal army used its river transport and its numbers to beat Lavalle at Pago Largo, then pushed the war across the Paraná, and the allied Colorados and Unitarians were harried and broken repeatedly; Lavalle fell back on Santa Fe in 1840 and was killed on 9 October 1841 in a skirmish in the province of Jujuy, and that phase contains no set-piece battle at all. The crossing of the Uruguay River by Echagüe and Lavalleja at Salto on 29 July 1839 was itself a turning movement: the federal army avoided the front held by Rivera at Durazno and went for Montevideo with a fast march, and Rivera answered by refusing battle, falling back across the Queguay and the Negro, holding a screen on the Santa Lucía, harassing the columns that detached themselves for cattle and breaking the campaign into a war of endurance, with Cagancha the one occasion on which he chose to stand and fight. The deployment at Cagancha is written in the numbers: Rivera had about three thousand men, mostly cavalry, with ten guns, putting eight hundred in the vanguard under Anacleto Medina, six hundred on the left under Ángel Núñez, the infantry and the guns, some seven hundred strong, in the centre under Enrique Martínez, five hundred on the right under Fortunato Silva and four hundred in reserve under Félix Aguiar; Echagüe, estimated at six to seven and a half thousand, put four thousand on each wing, in the centre only five hundred men and three four-pounders. The federal cavalry beat the Colorados on both wings early, but the pursuit dispersed them and broke the combination; the federal infantry in the centre was held by entrenchments and by the Colorados' fire, the Colorados' reserve struck the centre, and the federal army was forced back into Entre Ríos. The siege that followed was a textbook of urban defence: Montevideo held out for nine years behind the walls, towers and bastions of the old Spanish town, its garrison made up of the Oriental militia, French, Italian and free African battalions, kept alive by the port and by shipping; the besiegers worked from three camps on the approaches and attacked in turn, and in the end the siege was lifted only when Entre Ríos crossed at Paysandú, sixteen thousand Imperial Brazilian troops came overland, and Garibaldi's improvised squadron covered the mouth of the river.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。紅黨的里維拉於一八三九年三月一日當選總統，二月已簽署對羅薩斯的宣戰書，同月二十一日埃查瓜在帕戈拉戈擊潰貝隆·德·阿斯特拉達的縱隊，七月二十九日聯邦軍自薩爾托渡過烏拉圭河，十二月二十九日卡甘查開戰。卡甘查的兵力，紅軍總數三千至五千九百人，其中騎兵二千三百至四千二百、步兵七百至一千七百、砲十門；聯邦軍總數六千至七千五百人，其中騎兵五千五百一十五至七千、步兵四百八十五至五百、砲三門四磅砲。傷亡方面，紅軍三百二十三人陣亡、一百九十人負傷，另有沙爾迪亞斯記載的逾一千五百人傷亡說法；聯邦軍四百八十人陣亡、一千餘人負傷。圍城階段的兵力，一八四三年聯邦與白軍約三千六百三十人加上阿根廷聯邦軍三千五百五十人，圍城方守軍三千至八千人，另有法國一千五百至二千人、義大利軍四百至六百人、單元派五百人；一八五一年奧里韋一方一萬一千至一萬四千人，守方援軍為巴西帝國一萬二千至一萬九千人、恩特雷里奧斯五千人、科連特斯一千五百人。城市人口方面，一八四三年蒙得維的亞約三萬人，其中本地人只佔三分之一，義大利人四千二百零五人、西班牙人三千四百零六人、阿根廷人二千五百五十三人、葡萄牙人六百五十九人、英國人六百零六人、巴西人四百九十二人；守軍中自由非洲人營約五千人。時間上，圍城自一八四三年十一月十六日至一八五一年十月八日，前後九年；一八四六年英軍第七十三步兵團在城中守了七個月；一八五一年九月四日巴西一萬六千人入境，奧里韋於十月十九日投降；一八五二年二月三日卡塞羅斯一役羅薩斯的政權崩解。這場戰爭前後造成的死亡，估計在一萬至二萬五千人之間。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. Rivera was elected president on 1 March 1839, having already signed the declaration of war on Rosas in February; on 21 March Echagüe routed Berón de Astrada's column at Pago Largo; on 29 July the federal army crossed the Uruguay River at Salto; and the battle of Cagancha was fought on 29 December. At Cagancha the Colorados numbered three thousand to five thousand nine hundred men, of whom two thousand three hundred to four thousand two hundred were cavalry, seven hundred to one thousand seven hundred infantry and ten guns, against six to seven and a half thousand federal and Blanco men with five thousand five hundred and fifteen to seven thousand cavalry, four hundred and eighty-five to five hundred infantry and three four-pounder guns. On casualties the Colorados lost three hundred and twenty-three killed and one hundred and ninety wounded, with Saldías giving more than one thousand five hundred casualties, while the federal side lost four hundred and eighty killed and more than a thousand wounded. At the siege, in 1843, the besiegers had about three thousand six hundred and thirty Uruguayans and three thousand five hundred and fifty confederate soldiers against three to eight thousand defenders, with fifteen hundred to two thousand Frenchmen, four hundred to six hundred Italians and five hundred Unitarians; in 1851 Oribe had eleven to fourteen thousand men against reinforcements of twelve to nineteen thousand Imperial Brazilians, five thousand men from Entre Ríos and one thousand five hundred from Corrientes. In 1843 Montevideo had about thirty thousand inhabitants, of whom only a third were native-born, the rest including four thousand two hundred and five Italians, three thousand four hundred and six Spaniards, two thousand five hundred and fifty-three Argentines, six hundred and fifty-nine Portuguese, six hundred and six English and four hundred and ninety-two Brazilians; the free African contingent in the garrison numbered some five thousand. The siege ran from 16 November 1843 to 8 October 1851, nine years in all; the 73rd Regiment of Foot held the city for seven months in 1846; sixteen thousand Brazilian troops entered the country on 4 September 1851 and Oribe surrendered on 19 October; and Rosas fell at Caseros on 3 February 1852. The whole war is credited with between ten thousand and twenty-five thousand dead.
cause: 起因是獨立之後權力的分配，而外國勢力把衝突推成國際事件。一八二八年烏拉圭宣稱獨立後，獨立領袖拉瓦萊哈與老將里維拉爭奪主導權，里維拉在一八三〇年當選首任總統，一八三二年拉瓦萊哈的支持者行刺未遂，蒙得維的亞守軍在七月三日起事，兵敗後拉瓦萊哈逃往巴西南部的里奧格蘭德，一八三四年在羅薩斯支持下再度入境又被打退。一八三五年三月奧里韋當選第二任總統，收回里維拉的軍權並赦免拉瓦萊哈，一八三六年七月十六日里維拉起兵反抗，奧里韋命部下繫白袖章以資區別，里維拉的人先繫藍袖章，褪色後改用紅袖章，兩黨的名稱由此而來，紅黨代表蒙得維的亞的商業利益，白黨代表鄉村的農業利益。一八三六年九月十九日卡平特里亞一役紅軍敗北，幸賴里奧格蘭德共和國與後來法國的支援，一八三七年十月在尤庫圖哈、一八三八年六月十五日在帕爾馬爾連勝，才扭轉局面；一八三八年法國因羅薩斯在拉普拉塔河口對秘魯玻利維亞聯盟作戰而封鎖布宜諾斯艾利斯港，聲援紅黨，十月七日至十日布朗的東方分艦隊被解除武裝、馬丁·加西亞島淪陷，奧里韋在內外交困之下於十月二十四日辭職出走。直接引爆全面戰爭的是羅薩斯不肯承認里維拉政府的合法性，他支持奧里韋復位，聯邦軍並肩作戰，紅黨則以聯邦黨與單元黨之爭作為義戰的理由。於是一場原本是烏拉圭政黨鬥爭的事情，最終以「人類與文明對暴政」的姿態展開，變成英法、巴西、意大利與阿根廷各省爭相下注的國際棋局。
causeEn: The cause lay in how power was to be shared after independence, and foreign involvement turned a party quarrel into an international event. After independence was proclaimed in 1828, Juan Antonio Lavalleja and the veteran commander Fructuoso Rivera fought for precedence; Rivera was elected the first president in 1830, in June 1832 Lavalleja's supporters tried to kill him, the Montevideo garrison revolted on 3 July, and Lavalleja was beaten and fled to the Brazilian province of Rio Grande do Sul, from which he invaded again in 1834 with Rosas's support and was beaten once more. On 1 March 1835 Manuel Oribe was elected the second president, took the command of the army from Rivera and pardoned Lavalleja, and on 16 July 1836 Rivera rose in revolt. Oribe ordered his men to wear white armbands to tell them apart, Rivera's men first used blue, which faded, and then red, and the two parties took their names from the colours, the Colorados standing for the commercial interest of Montevideo and the Blancos for the agricultural interest of the countryside. Rivera was beaten at Carpintería on 19 September 1836 and only turned the situation with help from the Riograndense Republic and later from France, winning at Yucutujá in October 1837 and at Palmar on 15 June 1838. In 1838 France blockaded the port of Buenos Aires in support of Rosas's war against the Peru-Bolivian Confederation, and this helped Rivera's side; on 7 and 10 October Brown's Oriental squadron was disarmed and Martín García Island fell to the French, and Oribe resigned and left the country on 24 October. What set off the full-scale war was Rosas's refusal to recognise Rivera's government as legitimate: he backed Oribe's restoration, the federal army fought alongside the Blancos, and the Colorados justified the struggle as the cause of the unitarians and the federalists against tyranny. What had begun as a party dispute in Uruguay was thus fought in the name of humanity and civilisation against tyranny, and became an international board on which Britain, France, Brazil, Italy and the Argentine provinces all placed stakes.
impact: 影響分成三層。第一層是烏拉圭本身的建國：長達十二年的戰爭把國家分成紅白兩黨，並在蒙得維的亞製造出兩個並存政府、兩個首都、三萬守軍與一整套圍城軍事的行政與後勤機器；一八五一年圍城解除後，城市精英紅白兩派組成聯盟推動國家建設，一八五二年得以進行全國第一次人口普查。戰爭中雙方都宣布廢奴以換取兵力，這使烏拉圭的奴隸制在實務上提前崩解，數千名被解放者進入守軍與勞動隊伍，族群結構為之重寫。港口與航運的封鎖與反封鎖，使蒙得維的亞在九年間成為南美最忙碌的補給點之一，也帶來大量外國居民，城市的居民結構由本地人與西班牙後裔佔多數，變成義大利、法國、英國、巴西居民雜居的國際城市，加里波第的義大利遠征軍更成為義大利統一運動在海外的練兵場。第二層是阿根廷的走向：羅薩斯為支援奧里韋而介入烏拉圭，把聯邦黨的勢力壓到烏拉圭，也把自己綁上這場戰爭，烏爾基薩的倒戈與巴西的介入最終把羅薩斯送上卡塞羅斯的敗局，一八五二年阿根廷統一的條件由此成熟。第三層是列強的介入方式：英法兩國以封鎖河口的方式干涉南美內政，先後在布宜諾斯艾利斯與蒙得維的亞之間動用艦隊，此後南美洲的每一次內戰幾乎都伴隨外國的軍事干涉，成為一條延續至今的政治慣例。
impactEn: The effects run on three levels. The first is inside Uruguay: twelve years of war split the country into the two parties, produced two governments and two capitals in Montevideo, and left the city with thirty thousand defenders and an entire administrative and logistical machinery built for a siege. When the siege was lifted in 1851 the urban elites of both colours formed a coalition for state building, and the first national census of Uruguay could be taken in 1852. Both sides abolished slavery during the war in order to find troops, which in practice broke the institution of slavery in Uruguay early, and thousands of the emancipated entered the garrison and the labour gangs, rewriting the ethnic composition of the country. The blockade and the counter-blockade of the port and the river made Montevideo one of the busiest supply points in South America for nine years and brought a large foreign population, so that the city changed from one of locals and Spanish descendants into a cosmopolitan mixture of Italians, Frenchmen, Englishmen and Brazilians; Garibaldi's Italian expedition became an overseas training ground for the Italian unification movement. The second level is Argentine: Rosas's intervention on behalf of Oribe extended federal power into Uruguay and tied him to the war, and Urquiza's defection and the Brazilian intervention finally brought him to the field of Caseros, so that the conditions for Argentine unification were matured by 1852. The third level is the method of the great powers: Britain and France intervened in a South American civil war by blockading the river mouth, at one point against Buenos Aires and at another against Montevideo, and almost every later civil war in South America was accompanied by foreign interference of the same kind, which became a political habit running down to the present.
result: 結果是紅黨的最終勝利與白黨的長期流亡。一八三九年卡甘查一役里維拉以十門砲對三門砲的火力優勢贏得關鍵的一戰，聯邦軍退回恩特雷里奧斯；一八四〇年拉瓦爾在阿根廷境內的戰役慘敗，一八四一年陣亡，紅黨在阿根廷的外援斷了一角；一八四二年十二月六日奧里韋在阿羅約格蘭德擊潰里維拉，翌年圍城蒙得維的亞，但圍城本身反而把守軍與城市鍛成一體，守到一八五一年才鬆動：五月恩特雷里奧斯的烏爾基薩與防守方訂立同盟，七月十九日自佩桑杜渡河入侵，烏爾基薩的招降使奧里韋軍中大量士兵倒戈，奧里韋留下六千人圍城、派三千人迎戰，巴西帝軍一萬六千人九月四日入境，十月十九日奧里韋投降，圍城解除。一八五二年二月三日卡塞羅斯一役中羅薩斯敗於烏爾基薩，隨即辭職，烏拉圭的戰爭與阿根廷的內政由此合流，紅黨在烏拉圭取得主導，白黨退入山區與鄉村，其武裝衝突延續到一九〇四年才告結束。戰爭的物質結果也一併留下來：巴西與烏拉圭在一八五一年簽訂五條條約，烏拉圭獲得貸款與海運支持，同時放棄對卡雷姆河以北的領土要求，國土縮至約十七萬六千平方公里，並承認巴西在梅林湖與亞瓜龍河的航行權，烏拉圭的牧牛業在戰火中被摧毀，人口與城市的結構則在此後數十年裡徹底改變。
resultEn: The result was a final Colorado victory and the long exile of the Blancos. At Cagancha in December 1839 Rivera won the decisive action on the strength of ten guns against three, and the federal army fell back into Entre Ríos; Lavalle's campaign in Argentina in 1840 ended in ruin and his death in 1841, and the Colorados lost one of their supports in Argentina. On 6 December 1842 Oribe destroyed Rivera's army at Arroyo Grande and the following year besieged Montevideo, but the siege turned the garrison and the city into a single thing and held out until 1851: in May Urquiza of Entre Ríos concluded an alliance with the defenders, on 19 July he crossed the Uruguay River at Paysandú and his amnesty call brought mass desertions from Oribe's army, Oribe left six thousand to besiege the city and three thousand to meet the invader, sixteen thousand Imperial Brazilian troops entered the country on 4 September, and Oribe capitulated on 19 October, ending the siege. On 3 February 1852 Rosas was beaten by Urquiza at Caseros and resigned, which joined the Uruguayan war to Argentine politics and left the Colorados dominant in Uruguay while the Blancos withdrew to the interior and countryside, their armed resistance continuing until 1904. The material results came with it: five treaties signed with Brazil in 1851 gave Uruguay loans and shipping support in return for the renunciation of claims north of the Cuareim, reducing the country to about one hundred and seventy-six thousand square kilometres, and recognising Brazilian navigation rights on the Laguna Merin and the Yaguaron; the cattle industry was ruined by the fighting, and the demographic and urban structure of the country was permanently altered in the decades that followed.
